$comment: Public release records, newest first. scripts/check-dist.mjs enforces: an installer link needs an https URL, a SHA-256 and a notices page; a "gpl" engine build also needs a corresponding-source URL. Engine "gpl" = the third-party mpv/FFmpeg build with GPL parts (0.1.0); "lgpl" = our own LGPL build (ADR 0003, option B).

platforms.name: Windows 11 x64
platforms.state: Tested on one machine (install, upgrade from 0.2.0, uninstall, reinstall, Open with)

notes: Open with NOVA: File Explorer's Open with and Windows Settings › Default apps list NOVA for 36 video and audio types; NOVA never takes a default, and uninstalling removes only its own entries.
One window: files opened while NOVA runs go to the open window; several at once become one queue; subtitle files are added to what plays.
Settings › Formats: Default apps… and Repair registration.

Release pipeline ready for Authenticode signing, with a release gate that verifies signatures, the update signature, checksums and licences. This installer is not Authenticode-signed yet: SmartScreen will warn.
The installer's file properties name SNOWBROS as the publisher.
Redesigned player: a Full or Compact control bar (Compact is a small bar centred at the bottom), switched with one button or C.
Translucent header and controls; the picture shows through.

Timeline frame previews on hover, chapter marks and names, A–B loop bracket.
Subtitle size with Ctrl + mouse wheel or Alt+↑/↓, remembered between sessions; chapters on Shift+N / Shift+P.
In-app updates from signed GitHub releases (can be turned off); installer with NOVA's artwork.
Player deck with the beam playhead and a More menu for every tool.
Home, Library grid and list, Settings key search, Formats page.
Content-first file detection; editing projects and camera RAW explained.
Playback details panel; compatibility harness with 55 samples.
Local library with resume across restarts.
Licence texts, third-party notices and engine source information bundled with the installer.

$comment_android: Android APK records, newest first. Same rules as installers (https URL, SHA-256, notices); "cert" is the SHA-256 fingerprint of NOVA's signing certificate, which every APK must carry. A record with download null is announced but not yet attached.
